notes.title: Hitman: Contracts will be part of "BAFTA Games in Concert"!
notes.content: [p align="start"]We're excited to announce that [b]Hitman: Contracts[/b] will be part of a spell-binding night of award-winning music taking place at The Royal Festival Hall, London on 31st January 2026 as part of BAFTA Games in Concert.[/p][p]Come experience the prestigious BBC Concert Orchestra play live synchronised to in-game visuals and feel your favourite soundtracks like you never have before. It's going to be a special evening. Tickets are available now at: [url="https://www.liveconcert.games"]www.liveconcert.games[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5550213/191d7fa2db23db6efac4823ee853992d0c1c2cc5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: It's Hitman's 20th anniversary, so here are 20 facts about the silly stealth sim
notes.content:
Hitman: Codename 47

was released 20 years ago today. In all that time, IO Interactive have crafted an entertaining seven-game series (not including spin-offs), with the eighth aiming for the heart in January 2021. The subject matter might be grim, but from the very first game, IO Interactive were always happy to fold information and easter eggs into their immersive sim (don’t @ me) to a ridiculous degree. The games all have murderdeathkills, but they also have hauntings, mythical creatures, and real-world actors as targets.

I’ve had a blast digging up some forgotten facts and 47’s more bizarre moments (this does mean this list contains some spoilers, so beware). There are so many that this could have been 200 facts for 20 years, but I stuck with 20. It seemed right. Enjoy!
